families.semantics: Set/clear callbacks for actor field +0x3C bit 5 and actor flags +0x06 bit 0, used by AnimationVM and MovementVM streams.
Deferred random/audio callbacks selecting variant event IDs 0x5E-0x61 or parity events 0x44/0x40 under the VDP update gate.
Randomized actor offset callbacks deriving wide or narrow signed placement offsets from the incoming D7 value.

conclusion: The indirect AnimationVM callback family is now canonical and owns the formerly opaque 0x001ACC18-0x001ACDA1 callback regions, while preserving the existing helper at 0x001ACC30 and palette reload routine at 0x001ACDA2.
